title: AppearanceSpec
description: Cosmetic look of a creature. Purely visual: it must never change masses, collisions or the compiled MuJoCo model, so trained policies stay valid. Rendered by play/src/appearance (normalizeLook fills every missing field from the classic look, so a partial look is fine). Owner: look agent (may extend; keep this file the single source of truth, ai-service reads it at runtime). Unknown or missing fields fall back to defaults. Design tip: pick 2-3 strong palette colours, one pattern, at most one shell, and 1-3 accessories; character beats clutter.

theme.description: Free text label, e.g. 'ladybug', 'toy tank', 'jade dragon'.

palette.description: sRGB hex colours for the semantic parts. Missing entries are derived from body like the classic look (limbs lighter, joints and accent darker, feet dark green-grey).

accent.description: Small trims, the snout muzzle, and the default colour of accessories and motor caps; glows with finish 'glow'.

caps.description: Optional: the round caps on every motor face (16-18 per body). Defaults to accent; set it close to joints for calm animal looks, or bright for toy looks.

finish.description: matte/satin read like printed PLA (fine layer lines up close); gloss like lacquer or candy; metal like machined aluminium; toon is cel-shaded with ink outlines; glow makes the accent, the pattern and the eyes emissive (neon, lava).

pattern.description: Procedural surface pattern in the pattern colour over the base colour.

kind.description: spots: organic patches (cow, ladybug); dots: regular polka dots; stripes: wavy tiger/zebra stripes around the body; bands: clean rings (bee); gradient: base colour at the bottom to pattern colour on top; checker: race flag; camo: two-tone camouflage; panels: panel lines (space suit, robot, neon); cracks: veins/cracks (lava, ice, marble); scales: overlapping scales (dragon, fish); hex: honeycomb lines.

scale.description: Feature size; 1 = sized to the torso, 2 = twice as large.

target.description: Where the pattern goes. auto = the shell if there is one, else the body; all = body, shell and legs.

shell.description: Decorative printed shell over the torso, fitted to the real torso with clearance and arches over the hip motors; exportable as STL.

kind.description: dome: smooth cap with piping; beetle: split wing cases plus a front plate (ladybug); turtle: carapace with hex scutes; petals: ring of petals (flower); armor: overlapping plates with rivets (toy tank, armadillo); fluffy: cloud of puffs (sheep, moss, fur); saddle: blanket and saddle (pony).

size.description: 1 = snug fit; larger is puffier and taller.

face.description: Face features. Without a head they sit on top of the front edge (Draft quadrupeds have hip motors on the front face).

eyes.description: round: white with pupils in eyeColor; cute: big glossy dark eyes with an eyeColor iris and sparkles; visor: glass band with glowing eyeColor eyes (robot, astronaut); cyclops: one big eye; sleepy: half-closed lids; compound: faceted insect eyes in eyeColor. Eyes blink and glance around.

size.description: Eye size; above 1 reads younger and cuter.

head.description: Cosmetic head in front of the torso. round: cute ball head; boxy: robot or helmet head; snout: animal head with a muzzle in the accent colour and a nose (dog, tiger, cow, dragon).

mouth.description: beak uses the accent colour; whiskers adds a little nose; grill is a robot vent.

markings.description: patches: panda eye patches; mask: bandit mask band.

accessories.description: Cosmetic add-ons, each at most once. Head items sit on the head (or on top of the front edge without a head).

kind.description: antennae wobble on springs; ears twitch; tail sways; wings flutter; propeller spins; flower and sprout sway; halo floats. spikes run along the back (mane, dragon spines); fin is a dorsal fin; mushroom sits on the back; goggles rest on the forehead; scarf wraps the neck.

style.description: Visual covers for links and motors (never the physics): classic = Draft's own cylinders; sleek = slim tapered links and rounded motors; chunky = toy-like thick links and big hub caps; bones = bone shafts with ball joints.

feet.description: ball = Draft's sphere; paw = pad with toe beans; hoof = cloven hoof; pad = robot foot pad with tread.
